query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN birthDate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_birthdate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN beltLevel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_belt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phone NOT LIKE '%[a-zA-Z]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_real_phone
FROM students 
WHERE venue = '精英班道場';
